_comment: Every rate here was read from HighLevel's own pages on 2026-08-28 by the build
environment, not from a secondary source. Each block records its sourceUrl.
PUBLISH RULE: re-check before first publish and update verifiedOn.

plans.name: Starter
plans.bestFor: A single business or solo marketer. Three sub-accounts, unlimited contacts and users.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.bestFor: Growing agencies past three clients. Rebilling is available but at cost only.

plans.name: Agency Pro
plans.aliasNote: Marketed to SaaSPRENEURs. "SaaS Pro" is an alternate label for this same $497 plan, not a separate fourth tier.
plans.bestFor: Agencies reselling the platform as their own software with a margin on usage.

usage.smsNote: Per segment, US/Canada, inbound AND outbound at the same rate. This is a 10% discount on the $0.0083 list price. Carrier surcharges are charged ON TOP — see carrierFees.

carrierFees.note: Passed through by the recipient's carrier on top of the base segment rate. At the published per-carrier rates this adds roughly 45-65% to the cost of an outbound SMS, and it is the line almost every pricing article omits.

usage.voiceOutboundBreakdown: Outbound USA $0.0126/min (10% off $0.014 list) + Client Minutes $0.004/min.
usage.voiceTwoLegNote: Inbound calls bill TWO legs: the call arriving at your platform number, and the forwarded leg to wherever you answer. Both are billed.
usage.transcriptionNote: Call transcription at $0.024/min costs MORE than the outbound call it transcribes ($0.0166/min). Turning it on across a call centre roughly triples the per-minute cost.
usage.emailNote: LC Email. No free tier — all incoming and outgoing email (To, CC and BCC) is billed. Forwarding is billed at the same rate as sending.
usage.premiumWorkflowNote: Premium workflow actions bill per execution.

a2p.note: One-time brand and campaign registration, plus a recurring monthly campaign fee. Pass-through from The Campaign Registry and subject to change.
a2p.markupNote: A2P registration fees and SMS/MMS carrier fees carry a 5% markup when agency re-billing is enabled.

ai.vendorExample: HighLevel's own worked example: a conversation using 100,000 input and 25,000 output tokens costs $0.375.
ai.twoMeterWarning: HighLevel prices Voice AI as "Voice + token cost". The phone minutes are billed by LC Phone SEPARATELY from the AI tokens, on every plan including AI Employee Unlimited. Two meters run at once.
ai.fairUseWarning: AI Employee Unlimited is "unlimited, subject to fair use". Unlimited is throttleable under the terms.

models.name: Pay-per-use
models.estimateBasis: DERIVED, not published. HighLevel bills tokens, not messages. This assumes ~2,000 input + 500 output tokens per agent response at the published $1.25/1M input and $10.00/1M output rates. Your real figure depends on prompt and context length.

models.name: AI Employee Growth
models.note: 1,000 agent responses and 100 AI agent minutes per month per sub-account. Unlimited Reviews AI and Content AI. Overage falls back to token cost.

models.name: AI Employee Unlimited
models.note: Unlimited Conversation AI and Voice AI, subject to fair use. 3x Ask AI and AI Studio allowance.
models.commissionNote: The only AI tier that earns NodeRow a commission.

rebilling.marginTrapWarning: HighLevel bills your agency on ACTUAL consumption regardless of what you charge the sub-account. Set a flat rate below real usage cost and you absorb the loss on every unit.
rebilling.marginTrapQuote: Your agency continues to be charged by HighLevel based on actual token consumption for AI products, regardless of the pricing model configured for sub-accounts.

addOnsNote: HighLevel states most add-ons can be resold with your own markup on the Agency Pro plan. Eleven of the thirteen are billed PER SUB-ACCOUNT, so they scale with client count rather than being flat.
unverified: Extended 30/60-day trial length via affiliate links. The pricing page states 14 days on all three plans. Do not claim a longer trial without testing the link and screenshotting the result.
A one-time App Store submission fee for the white-label app, beyond the $497/month.
Default daily email/SMS sending caps by plan tier.
Typical agency monthly wallet spend. No official benchmark exists; any figure quoted as typical is a model.
